name: Dasheng D12
summary: Dasheng D12 is Wuba Intelligent’s full-size bipedal humanoid robot for public-facing service and industrial manipulation. Its articulated arms and hands support tasks such as reception, guidance, inspection and material handling. The manufacturer presents it as a general-purpose platform with sensing and multimodal interaction. The cover shows the grey D12 configuration in the manufacturer’s conference exhibit; current product-page images show a different exterior finish. Current purchase availability and shipment volume are unverified.
